name: ELFER R EVO

specs.notes: The 2026 update of the GT3 R: the rear-mounted 4,194 cc flat-six, about 416 kW (565 PS) to 9,250 rpm, subject to BoP; about 1,265 kg; a six-speed sequential dog box with paddles, a three-disc carbon clutch and a mechanical limited-slip differential; 2,507 mm wheelbase, 4,619 mm long, 2,039 / 2,050 mm wide (Porsche via stuttcars.com). Torque isn't published (a high-revving NA curve from the power); the power peak's rpm (9,000), ~290 km/h, weight distribution, ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: The 2026 evolution of the GT3 R: the same screaming flat-six behind the rear axle, a little heavier and a little calmer on the brakes.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit: its rectangular wheel cut out by part (its column given: the shape misleads), the seat found by the probe; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.

source.license: CGTrader purchase (no licence file in the package). Handled as no-AI: converted and checked by local scripts only, its renders never viewed

limitations: Not looked at: handled as no-AI, so its looks (materials, the cockpit) are checked by the tests only, never by eye.
Torque, the power peak's rpm, top speed, weight distribution, ratios and aero are estimates; the power is Porsche's BoP-dependent rating.
The game's livery replaces its race livery (its livery texture is the game's paint).
